seo.title: Contact
seo.description: Get in touch with IEEE EMBS at UCF about membership, projects, sponsorship, or collaboration.

hero.headline: Get in touch
hero.lede: Discord for quick questions, email for everything else.

channels.title: Discord
channels.body: Best for anything quick — how to join, which project to pick, when the next meeting is. Post in the general channel and an officer or project lead will answer.

channels.title: Email
channels.body: Best for anything that needs a written reply — sponsorship, speakers, equipment, lab collaborations, and questions about IEEE membership. It reaches the officers directly.
